title: (No AI) Fenix Flexin isn’t even denying using AI to make ‘Rubberz’ anymore
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![The seemingly AI generated cover art for Fenix Flexin’s Rubberz.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/artworks-WsdIgVXV8NOV-0-t1080x1080.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

That cover art is almost certainly AI too. | Image: Fenix Flexin

It [took long enough](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/974209/fenix-flexin-billboard-hot-100-rubberz-ai-slop), but now LA rapper Fenix Flexin appears to have [admitted](https://x.com/nfr_podcast/status/2085725158916956572?s=46) using AI for the 80s synth pop-themed song "Rubberz." His comments follow the [producer Medasin's videos](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fzkoENoDrbs) claiming that an AI tool called Treblo (formerly Sonauto) was used to make the song, [and the company](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/975528/fenix-flexin-ai-music-generator-treblo) releasing an [AI detector that identifies it as Treblo AI-created](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/975528/fenix-flexin-ai-music-generator-treblo).

In a reply to a comment pointing out that Tyga admitted to relying on AI for his own controversial '80s-influenced album _$tarface_, on one of his [Instagram posts](https://www.instagram.com/p/Dbt8TB3jSsY/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==), Fenix said:

> never said I didn't use AI , i said it had nun to do w recording process . I didn't even know what da app was till we mixed …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/976801/fenix-flexin-rubberz-ai-song-treblo)

title: (No AI) Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
author: Charles Pulliam-Moore
content:
![An AI-generated illustration of a man in a suit holding up a purple pocket watch.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-07-at-2.40.34-PM.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

The appeal of [free ad-supported streaming television](https://www.theverge.com/23680217/fast-services-tubi-roku-pluto-tv) (FAST) channels has always been the way they make it easier to (re)discover classic films and series. But Roku's latest experiment in the FAST space has less to do with traditionally produced entertainment and is entirely focused on giving viewers access to a constant source of AI-generated content.

This week, [Roku added four new channels](https://cordcuttersnews.com/roku-adds-4-new-free-channels-to-roku-tvs-roku-players-in-august-2026/) to its library of streamable programming. Along with dedicated feeds for old episodes of _Mad TV_, _Whose Line Is It Anyway?_, and a variety of Black sitcoms, the platform also debuted a 24/7 stream filled with projects from [Colin Petrie-Norris' AI startup, …](https://fairground.tv/)

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/976939/roku-fairground-ai-fast-channel)
